_README: Risk guardrails for executor.py (proposal engine) and live_bridge.py (the only code path that emits a real order). NOTHING is executed unless `enabled` is true AND `mode` is 'live' AND the bridge is driven from a session holding the Robinhood Agentic MCP; CI runs with EXECUTOR_KILL=1 and can never trade. LIVE since 2026-09-05 per owner direction. Fastest stops, in order: env EXECUTOR_KILL=1 · `enabled: false` · empty `allow_list` (fail-closed) · `block_list` per ticker. Read README.md > 'Agentic execution (Robinhood MCP)' and routines/live-execution.md.
_enabled_help: Master kill switch. false = propose-only no matter what `mode` says. The env var EXECUTOR_KILL=1 force-disables execution even when this is true (CI sets it, so the cron can never trade). Flipped true 2026-09-05 per owner direction ('start running the autopilot'); live placement happens ONLY through live_bridge.py from an MCP-attached Claude session — see routines/live-execution.md.
_mode_help: 'propose' = vet + log proposals, never execute (safe default). 'paper' = simulate fills against a virtual cash balance, no real money. 'live' = real orders in the Robinhood Agentic account. executor.py itself never places (it stays a proposal engine even in live mode); orders are placed by live_bridge.py driven from a Claude session holding the Robinhood MCP, which re-vets every proposal against the LIVE account (buying power, concentration, deploy cap, daily cap, cooldown, tradability) before anything is sent.
_account_value_help: Sizing basis for the CI proposal run; set to the Agentic-account funding ($500, re-confirmed via Robinhood MCP 2026-09-05). live_bridge.py ignores this and sizes against robinhood_snapshot.json total_value (the real account) at placement time.
_live_account_last4_help: Last 4 digits of the ONLY account live_bridge.py may place into (the isolated Robinhood 'Agentic' cash account). The bridge refuses to emit orders when the snapshot was read from any other account.
_snapshot_max_age_help: live_bridge.py refuses to emit orders when robinhood_snapshot.json is older than this (minutes) — a stale read of buying power / positions must never size a real order.
_max_proposal_age_help: Only proposals dated within this many days are placeable. The CI executor proposes every Monday; anything older has been superseded by a newer signal read or has gone quiet.
_rebuy_cooldown_help: Minimum days between two live buys of the same ticker. The same name is re-proposed every Monday while its signals stay lit (AAPL/MSFT: 4 consecutive weeks Aug 2026); without this the account would concentrate into 2 names within a month. 14d = at most two adds per name per month; the 25% per-name cap still binds on top.
_require_fractional_help: Live orders are dollar-based market orders ($50 of a $300-$1,000 stock = a fractional share). Robinhood does not allow fractional/dollar orders on OTC ADRs (AJNMY, TOTDY, SFTBY, TCEHY per get_equity_tradability 2026-09-05), so those names are skipped at the bridge even if they ever reach confluence — until a limit-order path exists.
_min_order_notional_help: Robinhood minimum for a dollar-based order.
_allow_list_help: ONLY these tickers can be traded. Empty list = nothing is tradable (fail-closed). This mirrors the StockNews stocknews_tickers coverage list, minus the non-tradable placeholders (ANTHROPIC, OPENAI, RESONAC). It is the primary blast-radius limit; trim it any time. Some entries are ADRs/foreign names that rarely surface in the SEC/Congress feeds — harmless, since a name still needs a live confluence signal to be proposed. REMOVED 2026-07-02: 'BYD' — on US exchanges that symbol is Boyd Gaming, NOT BYD Company (1211.HK, which the StockNews reports/BYD thesis covers); an order for 'BYD' would have bought the casino operator grounded in the Chinese EV maker's research, and the HK$305 anchor is unparseable so the price-sanity guard could not catch it. Re-add as BYDDY only once a reports/BYDDY thesis exists. REMOVED 2026-09-05: 'BIDU', 'JD', 'NTES', 'PDD' — no reports/{T}/tree_v1_en.md exists for any of them, and require_stocknews_thesis is true, so they could never be proposed; they only inflated the apparent blast radius. Re-add each once its StockNews tree ships.
_block_list_help: Hard deny, checked after allow_list. Use to pause a name without editing allow_list. 2026-09-05: the four OTC pink-sheet ADRs are blocked — no fractional/dollar orders on Robinhood, wide after-hours spreads (AJNMY showed $33.28 bid / $46.13 ask on 2026-08-12), and TCEHY is the sovereign-impaired bucket. Re-enable per name once a limit-order path exists in live_bridge.py.
_allowed_sides_help: ['buy'] = accumulate-only (conservative default; the agent can never sell your position). Add 'sell' only once you trust the loop.
_min_signal_feeds_help: Only act on confluence signals corroborated by at least this many independent feeds (congress / insider / 8-K / 13F / analyst / earnings). 3 = all-feed overlap only — the highest-signal subset.
_require_conviction_feed_help: Added 2026-07-02: at least one of the counted feeds must be skin-in-the-game (congress trade, insider open-market buy, or a material 8-K). Without this, analyst + earnings + 13F could clear min_signal_feeds on their own — three observational feeds that all just correlate with 'had a good quarter' (the 2026-06-29 MU proposal was exactly that).
_max_notional_help: Hard ceiling on a single order's dollar size.
_max_pct_help: Single order may not exceed this fraction of account value. Order size = min(max_notional_per_order_usd, account_value * max_pct_account_per_order). At $500 basis this resolves to $50/order (10% binds before the $250 ceiling).
_max_orders_help: Cap on orders placed (or proposed-as-executable) per calendar day, counted from executor_state.json. Lowered 5 -> 2 on 2026-07-02: at $50/order, 5/day could deploy 50% of the account in one session and hit the 70% total-deploy cap within two days — 2/day forces time diversification across signals.
_max_total_deployed_help: Stop opening new positions once cumulative deployed capital (sum of filled notionals) reaches this fraction of account value.
_order_type_help: 'market' or 'limit'. Limit orders also read limit_offset_pct.
_limit_offset_help: For limit buys, place the limit this fraction below last price (e.g. 0.01 = 1% below). 0 = at last price.
_derivatives_help: Both stay false. The executor never constructs options or margin orders; these flags exist so a future change can't silently enable them.
_share_size_display_help: How order size is shown on cards/scorecards posted to the (shared) agentic Discord: 'pct' = percentage of account (hides your balance), 'usd' = dollar amounts, 'none' = tickers only. Set to 'pct' so a channel with other people in it never leaks the account size.
_require_stocknews_thesis_help: Every trade must be backed by a StockNews research tree (reports/{TICKER}/tree_v1_en.md). true = skip any ticker with no thesis on file. The thesis is read and acknowledged on the proposal card + track record (see enrichment.py).
_max_fatal_flags_help: Skip a buy when the StockNews durability test fired more than this many fatal flags (Q3 capital allocation, Q4 disruption survival, balance-sheet survivability). 0 = any fatal flag blocks the trade.
_min_xii_score_help: Skip a buy when the StockNews Section XII weighted score is below this %. Bands: >=85 strong, >=65 moderate-buy, >=45 wait, <45 avoid. 45 = never buy a name the research rates 'avoid'.
_max_existing_position_help: Per-name concentration cap. Two readers: (1) executor.py at proposal time against the Stock-Portfolio app (only when STOCK_PORTFOLIO_URL + STOCK_PORTFOLIO_TOKEN are set; otherwise noted, not failed — still unset as of 2026-09-05); (2) live_bridge.py at placement time against the REAL Agentic-account positions + open orders in robinhood_snapshot.json — this second check is the one that actually binds, and it needs no secrets. At $500 this is $125/name = 2 adds after the first buy.
_min_conviction_help: Research-based purchase conviction floor: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'. Conviction is computed from the FULL StockNews thesis (XII quality + H-0 confidence + durability/25 + bull/bear asymmetry + thesis freshness), not the headline XII alone — so a high-XII / low-confidence / unfavorable-asymmetry name (e.g. COST: XII 91% but H-0 60%, bull<bear) lands at LOW and is skipped, while a high-XII / high-confidence / favorable name (e.g. GOOGL) lands at HIGH. 'medium' = only buy names the research backs with real confidence.
_block_decision_actions_help: Added 2026-09-05. The executor now reads the StockNews decision journal (reports/{T}/decisions.jsonl, latest row). When the research's own latest call is one of these, the buy is skipped (TOTDY 'wait', MP 'skip' today). 'watch' — the corpus default meaning a 0% position under observation — does NOT block: acting on confluence for watch-rated, ownable names is the executor's job. 'buy' / 'hold' pass.
_block_sovereign_bands_help: Added 2026-09-05. INDEX_META sovereign_exposure (schema v6, non-US names only). sovereign-impaired = home revenue + FX debt / capital controls / delisting risk (BABA, TCEHY per StockNews CLAUDE.md) — hard skip for this account. insulated / mixed / exposed pass and are sizing inputs, not gates.
_regime_gate_help: Added 2026-09-05 (R3 of research/agentic_decision_brief_2026-08-12.md). StockNews T-Capex-5 ('market de-rates capex increases') fired 2026-07-28 and is still lit per dashboards/macro_regime_overlay_2026-08.md. While active: names whose INDEX_META cycle_exposure is in `bands` need min_signal_feeds + extra_feeds corroboration (4 instead of 3) and their conviction is capped at cap_conviction (still >= min_conviction, so a 4-feed NVDA can trade — at medium, never high). Set active=false when StockNews retires the trigger. Names with no cycle_exposure field are unaffected.
_entry_price_anchor_max_ratio_help: Sanity guard on the entry price recorded in the track record: if a quote is more than this multiple off the StockNews anchor price (in either direction), it's treated as a bad print (wrong symbol / decimal error) and the entry price is left null rather than polluting the scorecard. 5.0 catches order-of-magnitude errors while letting any realistic price move through. No anchor on file -> the quote is accepted as-is.
